postconditions.expression: all(1 <= m_i <= n_i <= 10**9 for n_i, m_i in results)
postconditions.description: Each pair (n_i, m_i) must satisfy the condition 1 <= m_i <= n_i <= 10**9.

postconditions.expression: all(n_i * n_i - (n_i - m_i)**2 == x_i for x_i, n_i, m_i in zip(x_values, n_values, m_values))
postconditions.description: The number of 1's in the constructed m_i-free n_i × n_i matrix must be exactly x_i.

postconditions.expression: all(x_i == 0 or m_i > 1 for x_i, m_i in zip(x_values, m_values))
postconditions.description: If x_i is 0, then m_i must be greater than 1.

postconditions.expression: all(x_i == 1 or n_i > m_i for x_i, n_i, m_i in zip(x_values, n_values, m_values))
postconditions.description: If x_i is 1, then n_i must be greater than m_i.
